stages.name: Flourishing
stages.description: The beginning of the Major signifies the start of another sumptuous feast. The knights maintain their social etiquette before the games begin, a last-ditch show of chivalry.

stages.name: City Lights
stages.description: Learn how to seek out the lights within Kazimierz cities, how to avoid the darkness lurking in their shadows, and how to properly enjoy life. < Nightfall > Operators cannot be deployed on tiles where you do not have visibility. Enemies in areas without visibility are treated as Invisible < City Neon > Provides an initial amount of visibility, and can further increase visibility when used

stages.name: Marigold
stages.description: The marigold relishes the sun, but what of the night's moonglow? The moon's light hardly concerns the marigold. < Nightfall > Operators cannot be deployed on tiles where you do not have visibility. Enemies in areas without visibility are treated as Invisible < City Neon > Provides an initial amount of visibility, and can further increase visibility when used

stages.name: Last-Ditch Thrust
stages.description: A person full of faith towards life. A person who harbors malice towards all. In both their hearts is a thorn of resentment, one that stabs at their desires or perhaps any other bit of conscience. < City Neon > Provides an initial amount of visibility , and can further increase visibility when used

stages.name: Preparing
stages.description: The person who prepares to climb great mountains and the person who prepares to hunt great beasts may have completely different mental states, but their willingness to face down the unknown is one in the same. < City Neon > Provides an initial amount of visibility , and can further increase visibility when used

stages.name: A Poem's Looks
stages.description: If Kazimierz's poetry was a knight, then she could be none other than a woman named Viviana . Her name shines brightly, whereas marigold and moon alike are bland. < City Neon > Provides an initial amount of visibility , and can further increase visibility when used

stages.name: Right and Might
stages.description: Does power enable people to rebel against fate, or does fate inevitably draw out the power within people?

stages.name: Rogue Knights
stages.description: The love of things material has always roused peoples' primitive passions, among which violence is the most conspicuous. Beware the most zealous of knight enthusiasts, for there is little they aren't capable of doing. < Knight Crest > When used, permanently provides visibility over a certain tile

stages.name: Gossip Kills
stages.description: Anything unspoken is doomed to disappear. < City Neon > Provides an initial amount of visibility , and can further increase visibility when used < Knight Crest > When used, permanently provides visibility over a certain tile

stages.name: The Surrounded
stages.description: Every warrior is surrounded by enemies. Every citizen is surrounded by the city. Every city is surrounded by the boundless wilderness. < Knight Crest > When used, permanently provides visibility over a certain tile Some Operators cannot be deployed.

stages.name: City Fast Asleep
stages.description: A gloompincer hiding in the shadows raises its head in this moment. It is the first time it sees the awakened starry sky.

stages.name: Afterdream
stages.description: Dreams are an extension of one's beliefs, from the traveler who knows no pause, to the dazed warrior, to the butcher looking up at the sky. < Knight Crest > When used, permanently provides visibility over a certain tile

stages.name: The Last Kheshig
stages.description: The Nightzmora looks back at his past life – the old knight squats before the yellow sand with tears in his eyes, his Khagan sharpening his machete not far away. < City Neon > Provides an initial amount of visibility , and can further increase visibility when used < Knight Crest > When used, permanently provides visibility over a certain tile

stages.name: A Sigh
stages.description: Fear derived from imagination is nothing for those who have long realized the truth of life. < Knight Crest > When used, permanently provides visibility over a certain tile

stages.name: The Radiant Knight
stages.description: A knight who harbors faith in her heart came forward, but we mocked her. But should there be no such knights remaining, we would simply blame that on the changing times. < City Neon > Provides an initial amount of visibility , and can further increase visibility when used

stages.name: Uncharted and Hereafter
stages.description: The sun rises, the veil of night parts. Perhaps nothing has changed, but perhaps the future has already sealed its victory in this moment.

stages.name: Urban Legends
stages.description: In the Grand Knight Territory , gloompincers are hardly newsworthy. But should they congregate in the sewers, they are cruel and violent. Who knows, they might even climb along the water pipes into your home? < City Neon > Provides an initial amount of visibility , and can further increase visibility when used

stages.name: Fair Conjecture
stages.description: Recently, a nutritional drink for better sleep has become all the rage in the market. To achieve the next phase of promotional marketing, the editor interviewed two piss-drunk, passed-out knights to write an article demonstrating the effects of the drink. < City Neon > Provides an initial amount of visibility , and can further increase visibility when used

stages.name: Reusing Material
stages.description: Another sleeping drink developed by a large conglomerate seems to be hitting the market soon, so a new article will be released after slightly modifying the knights' interview and changing some names around. < Knight Crest > When used, permanently provides visibility over a certain tile

stages.name: Free Market
stages.description: The Kazimierz Major souvenir sales continue to boom, and merchandise is in short supply. Even some Armorless Union members are trying to take the lead by "purchasing" hot-selling figures after the mall's closing hours. < Knight Crest > When used, permanently provides visibility over a certain tile

stages.name: Fanatic Fans
stages.description: Beware the fans of the Nightmare Knight - they will make it hard for you to sleep. Whether they become as nightmares that invade your sweet dreams, or simply end up as ruffians who make a racket outside your house with their strange rituals... is for the reader to decide. < Knight Crest > When used, permanently provides visibility over a certain tile

stages.name: Performance Art
stages.description: A bunch of people are walking around in an organized manner in the dead of night... If it's not a flash mob, then what the heck is it? Wait, wait, are those people from The White Wine? Hurry, hurry, send out an announcement quick, don't let them beat us to the scoop! < City Neon > Provides an initial amount of visibility , and can further increase visibility when used

stages.name: Backup Club
stages.description: The knights face each other on the battlefield, and their fan organizers get together to feast. As long as there are photos, then there's a headline to be made, haha! Oh, shoot, we've been found out! < City Neon > Provides an initial amount of visibility , and can further increase visibility when used

stages.name: Exclusive Interview
stages.description: Can we use this sound sample recorded from the door of the Blood Knight 's house as exclusive interview materials? There's not enough? Then, stitch it together with his last speech. Hurry up, we've also got to do an interview with Nearl . We'll throw it all together at the end. < City Neon > Provides an initial amount of visibility , and can further increase visibility when used

stages.name: Secret Passage
stages.description: Businessmen have a keen sense of self-preservation, which is why there are dark, intricate passages inside the headquarters of the General Chamber of Commerce, inspected and maintained by dedicated personnel. < Knight Crest > When used, permanently provides visibility over a certain tile Condition: Enemies have greatly increased HP, and increased ATK, and tiles do not have melee/ranged deployment restrictions.

stages.name: Victory Boulevard
stages.description: I heard that every night, the Nightmare Knight stalks the long street leading to the exhibition hall of the Wall of Champions, looking for a worthy opponent. < City Neon > Provides an initial amount of visibility , and can further increase visibility when used < Knight Crest > When used, permanently provides visibility over a certain tile Condition: Coalescing Fear multiplier increased; Tola and Nightzmora Followers have increased Max HP.

stages.name: Nova Camp
stages.description: The headquarters of the Nova Knightclub is located here, and the Candle Knight visits when she is here on official business. At that time, the neon brilliance illuminating the sky gives way to the flickering of candles. < City Neon > Provides an initial amount of visibility , and can further increase visibility when used Condition: The cast range of Glimmering Touch is greatly increased.

stages.name: Crimson Chalice Camp
stages.description: The headquarters of the Crimson Chalice Knightclub is located here. The Blood Knight has his own room, treating guests cordially with fine wine served from a chalice while driving enemies away with a long, blood-like blade. < City Neon > Provides an initial amount of visibility , and can further increase visibility when used < Knight Crest > When used, permanently provides visibility over a certain tile [ note 1 ] Condition: All enemies have increased DEF and Max HP.

stages.name: Armorless Union Stronghold
stages.description: The Armorless Union is one of the many strongholds of the Grand Knight Territory , a throne from which the two Lazurites plan their next upcoming missions. < City Neon > Provides an initial amount of visibility , and can further increase visibility when used Condition: Enemies deal increased Corrosion .
